name: aestrodom-demo-video
description: Aestrodom product demo video, built with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render AestrodomDemo out/raw.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/aestrodom-demo.mp4
scripts.render:promo: remotion render AestrodomPromo out/promo-raw.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/promo-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k ../aestrodom-promo.mp4
